instrument.description: Consumer. The Instrument monorepo, root package @instrument-org/monorepo. Wires format.mjs into .claude/settings.json and .codex/hooks.json and installs this package as a root devDependency; a change here lands there through `pnpm update @instrument-org/agent-hooks` and a lockfile commit.

internal.description: Consumer. The platform API (apps/api) and the marketing and account site (apps/web), root package @instrument/internal. Same wiring and update path as instrument.

skills.description: Consumer. The skills registry, root package @instrument-org/skills. Same wiring and update path as instrument.
